attr.title: UltraCombo (Killer Instinct 1 & 2)
attr.desc: Native ports of the Killer Instinct arcade games for RK3326 handhelds. The arcade code is translated to C and compiled for aarch64 (prebuilt modules included), with the Midway DCS sound board and IDE hard disk emulated. Two entries: Killer Instinct 1 (L1.5D/L1.4) and Killer Instinct 2 (L1.4). Save states, rewind, run-ahead, training and netplay are in the in-game menu.
attr.inst: Game files (ROMs and CHDs) are included in ultracombo/run. To use your own dumps, put the ROMs of MAME's kinst/kinst2 sets and kinst.chd/kinst2.chd in ultracombo/run and delete ultracombo/cache so the translation is rebuilt.
